propositions: Eight Jira modules currently at package root must be physically moved into adapters/jira/ per ADR 0035.
The lazy_load function must be taught to resolve three location-pinned modules (adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits) via relative subpaths without breaking ~30 other root module loads.

All surviving dotted imports and sibling-path references across jira_fields.py, inbound_fields.py, acli.py, acli_cli_ops.py, and test files must be repointed to the new adapters/jira location atomically with the move.
No re-export shims or intermediate imports may remain at old root paths after relocation.
The full test suite and structural gate (grep verification of zero old-path references, module-size limits) must pass with the move complete.
